components.title: R · 统计计算

components.title: Julia · 科学计算
components.instructions: Install Julia using its upstream installer or connect an existing executable; select the project with --project.

components.title: ngspice · 电路模拟
components.instructions: Install ngspice for the execution host, then bind the executable. Circuit netlists use its native syntax.

components.title: Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab
components.instructions: Import and activate the upstream plugin in the host. Use its prepare/bind operations for scientific solvers; existing OPTICS_HOME remains authoritative.

components.title: IOP · 实验平台
components.instructions: Follow the upstream connection guide and select the existing instrument host. Preserve its device connections and experiment state.

components.title: Crossref · 文献元数据
components.instructions: Use the existing host HTTP or literature connector, or the included httpx example. Crossref metadata is publicly accessible.

components.title: SQLAlchemy / psycopg · 数据库客户端
PostgreSQL · 研究数据库连接
components.instructions: Select an existing database connection in the host. Keep account credentials in its connection settings; use the prepared SQLAlchemy or psycopg client.

components.title: prysm
components.instructions: prysm 0.21.1 imports pkg_resources; use a compatible setuptools environment, or a newer upstream release that removes this dependency.

components.title: Perceval
components.instructions: drawsvg 2.4.1 and later fail to import with Perceval 1.3.1, so the recipe keeps an earlier drawsvg.

components.title: pyDHM
components.instructions: pyDHM 1.0.5 angularSpectrum uses np.exp2(i*pi*z*kz) instead of exp(i*2*pi*z*kz), so its propagation phase differs from the angular-spectrum operator. Use a corrected upstream implementation or a separately checked propagation program. Other pyDHM modules can be bound through an existing environment.

components.title: Meep / MPB
components.instructions: Use conda-forge pymeep on Linux/macOS, then bind this environment’s Python. On Windows choose WSL or a Linux server. The PyPI package named meep is unrelated.

components.title: Raysect
components.instructions: Raysect publishes wheels for Linux x86-64 only; elsewhere pip compiles it, which needs a C compiler and Cython.

components.title: SMUTHI
components.instructions: pip install smuthi compiles Fortran code and needs gfortran; there is no conda-forge build.

components.title: Finesse 3
components.instructions: Finesse 3.0.2 imports IPython and publishes wheels for Linux x86-64 and macOS arm64; elsewhere pip compiles it from source.

components.title: PtyPy
components.instructions: PtyPy is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI. MPI and GPU engines need their own libraries.

components.title: Strawberry Fields
components.instructions: Prepare the upstream compatible Python environment, then bind it. Choose any TensorFlow backend separately; this module does not download a GPU runtime.

components.title: MCX
components.instructions: Prepare MCX and the supported CUDA/OpenCL device runtime on the execution host; bind its Python interface pmcx. Installing an interface alone does not provide a GPU.

components.title: PyTorch
components.instructions: Choose the upstream CPU/CUDA/ROCm build for the execution host, or connect its existing PyTorch interpreter. Weights and training datasets are separate selections.

components.title: JAX
components.instructions: Prepare the upstream CPU/GPU/TPU build on the chosen execution host, then bind its Python. Accelerator plugins are selected for that host.

components.title: laserfun
components.instructions: laserfun is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI.

components.title: py-fmas
components.instructions: py-fmas is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI.

components.title: DEVSIM
components.instructions: DEVSIM needs BLAS/LAPACK. On x86-64 Linux/Windows this recipe includes Intel MKL, a substantial native dependency. macOS uses system math libraries; ARM Linux needs a supported system BLAS. Connect an existing solver environment to reuse its math libraries.

components.title: ADDA
components.instructions: Install the upstream serial/MPI build for the chosen host, or connect an existing executable.

components.title: RefractiveIndex.INFO
components.instructions: Select the required material records from the upstream YAML database or connect a local copy. This selection does not download the entire database.
